name: print-social-blue-yellow-red-doodle-restaurant-concert-instagram-set
title: Doodle Concert and Menu Instagram Set
whatItIs: A periwinkle board with six tilted Instagram post mockups for a venue: artist announcement, programme, concert title, menu, band photo and invitation, all in cream, navy, yellow and red with playful doodles of instruments, disco balls and food.
whatItMeans: Bold hand-drawn shapes and tilted posts give a festive, lively mood, and consistent doodles tie the set.
techniques: Tilted post frames on a flat colour background
Hand-drawn doodle icons (guitars, disco balls, forks)
Navy display type with red highlights
Photo circles cut inside the artwork

vocabulary.definition: A family of simple hand-drawn icons used as decoration.
Posts rotated to add energy to a presentation.
A loose coloured shape behind content.
